The machine head is black with a silver handwheel.
The stand includes a foot pedal and a large drive wheel.
The photo has a plain grey background and professional lighting, resembling a studio or stock photo.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BABARINDE OLUWASEUN' is visible across the center.
No brand name or model number is legible on the machine head or stand.

identity.kind: manual sewing machine with treadle stand

Mechanical function cannot be confirmed through a still photo.
Accessories like the bobbin case, needles, or small tools are not shown.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock image and not represent the actual item for sale.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine in a domestic setting with a handwritten note showing the seller's name and today's date.
risks.if_unproven: as a potential scam or non-existent item

risks.risk: The machine may be seized, have timing issues, or broken internal gears.
risks.proof: A video of the machine being operated via the treadle and successfully sewing a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic brand rather than a genuine Singer.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand badge or gold decals on the machine head.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic unbranded sewing machine

proof_requests: Photo of the actual machine in its current location with a handwritten note containing your name and date.
Close-up photo of the brand name/logo on the machine head.
Video of the machine sewing through two layers of fabric.
Photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate open.
response.reason: The photo provided is a studio-quality image that does not show the actual condition of a 'fairly used' item, nor does it confirm the claimed 'Singer' brand. Proof of ownership and condition is required before a price can be determined.
